ja292:1.1: In Benares, great king, a king of the crows dwells,
ja292:2.1: His pregnant wife Suphassā wished to feast upon
ja292:2.3: The king’s own costly food cooked in the king’s kitchen.
ja292:3.1: Amongst these I’m the messenger who was sent,
ja292:3.3: I pay respects to my master,
ja292:3.4: I made a wound upon his nose.
